notes: 02: no remote metadata fetching; title falls back to hostname, favicon is derived from hostname via a 3rd-party icon URL client-side, no description/preview collection. 03: title/description are editable before and after saving, but nothing is auto-collected to edit. 04: edits url/title/description/tags but there is no note field. 06: create() always pushes a new record; no duplicate-url detection or convergence to editing. 10: tags entered via plain text input, no autocomplete/datalist of existing tags. 12: search covers title/description/url/tags but no note exists to search. 14: query is literal substring; tags stored without '#', so '#tag' syntax is not honored. 15: no AND/OR/NOT or parentheses parsing. 16: no quoted-phrase exact-match handling. 17-19: no unread flag, unread view, or mark-read. 20-21: no multi-select or bulk actions. 22: list is always sorted by createdAt desc; no user-selectable sort key. 23: no markdown note field or rendering. 24-25: no HTML/PDF snapshot or Internet Archive support. 26-28: no archived flag, archive/delete distinction, or archive view. 29: no bundles. 30-31: no Netscape HTML import/export. 32: no user settings (sort/items/font size).
